title: Harmonic Dueller

sources.title: Mellow Harmony
markers: | description = You make a {{Ability check|Performance|15}}, success granting all your melee weapon attacks additional damage equal to your [[Charisma|Charisma modifier]] (minimum 1 additional damage).

sources.title: Flourish
markers: | description = Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent {{SmCond|Off Balance}}.

sources.title: Weakening Strike
markers: | description = Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict {{SmCond|Weak Grip}}.

summary: A +1 rapier. Mellow Harmony can add your Charisma modifier to melee weapon damage.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 1 Piercing plus the attack ability modifier, 5 ft melee. Martial, one-handed and Finesse.
fields.Mellow Harmony: Action targeting self once per Short Rest. Make a DC 15 Performance check. Success adds your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) as damage to your melee weapon attacks with any weapon for 10 turns. Unequipping Harmonic Dueller ends the buff.
fields.Weapon actions: With proficiency, gain Flourish, Piercing Strike and Weakening Strike.
fields.Base value: 380 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
